introHtml: Custom recycled sticky notes flags let you promote your brand while supporting sustainability. Made from post-consumer waste, these notes are ideal for offices, trade shows, or direct mail campaigns. Choose from standard sizes like 3x3 or 3x5 inches, and add your logo in full color. They stick firmly and remove cleanly, making them a practical giveaway for marketing directors and HR teams alike.
